calibration.status: experimental: not authorised for production; nothing in the app reads this file

method.senateRace: 40-bin margin histogram widened around the published margin (bin edges c+s(x-c), counts unchanged); prob moved by the change in the histogram's share above 0; p10/p90 stretched around the margin
method.houseRace: probit: p' = Φ(Φ⁻¹(p)/s); p10/p90 stretched around the margin
method.chamberControl: probit on the published control probability
method.expectedSeats: Republican seats not up + sum of the adjusted race probabilities (race prob is P(Republican win)); expectation only, no joint simulation
method.notComputed: seat histograms, medians, seat intervals and correlations need Lester's joint simulation; reported as unavailable
